en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with decorative frames showing two street scenes of a colonial town with single‑story houses, trees and pedestrians. The title text reads "Recordação d'Inhambane" with illustrated banana leaves and scrollwork. Each inset photograph is captioned with a street name: one is "RUA MOUSINHO D'ALBUQUERQUE" and the other "RUA VICTOR DE PORTUGAL". There is cursive handwritten text filling the lower part of the card.
